description: This file contains the implementation of a cache class named CaffeineCache that leverages the Caffeine caching library to provide asynchronous and synchronous cache operations with metrics support. It offers methods for cache retrieval, insertion, invalidation, and batch invalidation, as well as cache size metrics.

classes.name: CaffeineCache
classes.description: A generic cache implementation backed by Caffeine, supporting asynchronous and synchronous operations with optional metrics collection.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a CaffeineCache with a provided AsyncCacheLoader.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a CaffeineCache with a null cache loader, suitable for manual cache population.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a CaffeineCache with a null cache loader and a specific cache name for metrics.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a value from cache or loads it if not present.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value asynchronously with a mapping function if absent.

methods.name: getIfPresent
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a value if it is present in the cache.

methods.name: getBlocking
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves a value from the cache, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates a cache entry for the given key.

methods.name: invalidateAll
methods.description: Invalidates a batch of keys in the cache.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts or updates a cache entry.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Returns a view of the cache as a concurrent map.
